hero.heading:
Make Better Target Decisions
Before You Drill.
hero.body: Transforming exploration from pattern matching to Computational Geological Reasoning™.

prediction.body: Prediction shaped the last generation of exploration.

firstPrinciples.heading: Ore deposits are not predictable.
firstPrinciples.body: Deposits footprints are noisy, localized expressions of underlying mineral systems.
firstPrinciples.paragraphOne: While observations are incomplete and inconsistent, the systems themselves are governed by invariants.
firstPrinciples.paragraphTwo: Understanding comes from identifying what remains consistent within noise - not from pattern matching.
firstPrinciples.paragraphThree: Prediction fails where the system is not understood.

problem.label: PROBLEM
problem.preIntro: Exploration operates on sparse, indirect, and often conflicting observations.
problem.heading: Decisions Are Made Under Noise
problem.body: What we observe at the deposit scale is noisy and incomplete - yet mineralisation models used for decision-making are built on these observations, shaped by noisy patterns and subjective interpretation.
problem.bulletThree: Limited ability to test competing interpretations

limitations.heading: Patterns Don’t Equal Understanding
limitations.paragraphOne: Most approaches rely on statistical patterns and assumed transferability.
limitations.paragraphTwo: They treat deposits as comparable - even when the underlying systems differ.
limitations.bulletOne: Models fit noise in sparse and incomplete datasets
limitations.bulletThree: Outputs are accepted rather than rigorously challenged
limitations.closing: The result is the illusion of predictive accuracy - without grounding in the underlying system.

reasoning.heading: Generate. Test. Reject.
reasoning.body: At scale, before drilling decisions are made.
reasoning.intro: IREX applies a rigorous reasoning process:
reasoning.stepOneBody: Construct multiple geological hypotheses using structured data and mineral-system topology.
reasoning.stepTwoBody: Evaluate each hypothesis against evidence and system constraints.
reasoning.stepThreeBody: Eliminate interpretations that fail to satisfy invariant relationships.

principle.body: While observations vary, the underlying geological processes follow invariant relationships. IREX identifies and reasons over these invariants — treating each target as a system to be understood, not a pattern to be matched.
principle.closing: EXPLORATION IS A REASONING PROBLEM, NOT PREDICTION.

transparency.heading: Designed for Auditability
transparency.itemTwoBody: Explicit links between data and conclusions
transparency.itemThreeBody: Clear justification for accepted and rejected hypotheses
transparency.closingFirst: Every decision can be inspected and challenged.
transparency.closingSecond: Every outcome can be examined and verified.

control.heading: Built for Control
control.body: Designed for environments where control, reliability, and data ownership are non-negotiable.
control.itemTwoBody: No sensitive data leaves your environment
control.itemSixBody: Domain expertise explicitly encoded into system reasoning
control.closing: The system operates fully within your control — technically, operationally, and decisively.

value.heading: Reduce Risk Before It Becomes Capital
value.body: IREX fundamentally improves how high-stakes exploration decisions are made.
value.itemOne: Generate and evaluate multiple geological scenarios rapidly
value.itemTwo: Test interpretations before committing to drilling
value.closing: IREX optimizes for Decision Quality, Not Prediction Accuracy.

positioning.heading: IREX Is Not Another prediction model.
positioning.body: It is a reasoning system designed to identify invariants within noisy data — enabling decisions grounded in system understanding, not statistical patterns.

cgr.intro: Geological reasoning has guided mineral discovery for generations.
cgr.standout: CGR™ extends geological reasoning into computational systems.
cgr.body: CGR™ extends beyond prediction by transforming exploration data into structured geological knowledge, systematically generating, testing, and rejecting competing interpretations to converge on the most evidence-supported geological hypotheses under uncertainty.
cgr.closing: IREX® is developing, validating, and commercialising CGR™ as a new category of exploration intelligence for decision-making under uncertainty.

apply.heading: Early Adopter Program
apply.body: For leaders responsible for exploration strategy, capital allocation, and high-stakes decisions under uncertainty.

site.footerTagline: CGR™ is the next evolution of exploration intelligence.

application.heading: Better Decisions. Fewer Costly Errors.
application.body: Foundation Partners gain an early voice in defining how Computational Geological Reasoning™ is applied to real exploration decisions.
